lines.zh: 我摆尾游过河底的石子。
lines.en: A sweep of my tail takes me over the river gravel.

lines.zh: 这条河很浅，我贴着底走。
lines.en: The river is shallow. I travel along the bottom.
I ride the current downstream.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一开一合，像扇子。
lines.en: My fins open and close like a fan.

lines.zh: 我从一根沉木下面穿过去。
lines.en: I pass under a sunken log.
The light patches on the surface shift.
I turn into a hollow near the bank.
I am half a block long.

lines.zh: 河底的沙被我带起来一点。
lines.en: I lift a little sand from the bed.
I swim up to the reed roots.
I pause, then stroke forward.

lines.zh: 我在水草之间绕来绕去。
lines.en: I wind my way among the water weeds.

lines.zh: 暗流把我推得打了个转。
lines.en: The undercurrent spins me half around.

lines.zh: 我从石缝间一摆尾就过去了。
lines.en: One tail flick carries me through the stone gap.
My shadow falls on the shallows.
I lift my head and my mouth touches the surface.
I hang in the water with my fins moving.
The stones on the bed are rounded.
A small insect landed on the surface.
I stay at the edge of the weeds.
Water passes my gills, cool.
My eyes see a long way.

lines.zh: 有一片叶子顺水漂下来。
lines.en: A leaf drifts down with the current.
I turn slowly toward the bank.
The silt has a smell to it.

lines.zh: 我吐了一个泡，它浮上去了。
lines.en: I let a bubble go and it rises.
The water in this bend is still. Good for staying.

lines.zh: 我看见水面上有什么在动。
lines.en: I see something moving on the surface.
My scales are pale and catch the light.

lines.zh: 我沉到水草根里，只留背鳍。
lines.en: I sink to the weed roots, only my fin showing.
You stand in the river to your calves.
I am by your feet and you do not see me.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅水，我立刻转头。
lines.en: You step into the shallows, and I turn at once.
I am shorter than your palm.
Hold still and let me look at you.
The water is clear and hides nothing.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子游了半圈。
lines.en: I swim half a circle around your boots.

lines.zh: 我只有半格长，石头都比我大。
lines.en: Half a block long; the stones are bigger than I am.
I swim faster than you walk.
To catch me you must stoop.
A fin has been torn.
I dart under a stone.
A little blood clouds the water.

lines.zh: 背鳍被拍了一下，我歪进沙里。
lines.en: A blow hits my dorsal fin; I tilt into the sand.
I lose my hold and drift down.

lines.zh: 身子歪了，我还在往前摆尾。
lines.en: My body is crooked, yet I keep beating my tail.
In the Hell Creek river, my tail flicks.

lines.zh: 这一点伤，河会替我盖住。
lines.en: This small wound the river will hide.
I slip into the shadow of the weeds.

lines.zh: 我的尾摆得比刚才慢了。
lines.en: My tail beats slower than before.
An insect on the surface. I look up.
That morsel is too small for me.
I will not eat what is in your hand.
It sank and I caught it.
One mouthful, but enough.
I bit nothing; water filled my mouth.
Wrong taste. I spat it out.
Anything on the surface, I eat.

lines.zh: 我把头伸出去，又缩回来。
lines.en: I poke my head out and pull it back.

lines.zh: 这点食物，不值得靠近你。
lines.en: That is not worth coming near you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子碰到我的尾巴了。
lines.en: Your boot touched my tail.
One tail stroke and I dart away.
Your steps have muddied the water.
I pass between your legs.
That bump means little to me.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩下去，我躲开了。
lines.en: Your foot came down and I dodged.

lines.zh: 水花把我们都推了一下。
lines.en: The splash pushed us both.
I retreat behind a stone.
You stepped on water, not on me.
Make room. I am heading for the deep.

lines.zh: 这条河里还有几条同类。
lines.en: There are a few of my kind in this river.
They are a little bigger than me.
We gather in the weeds as a group.
If anyone swims over, we scatter.
One of them is always beside me.
We drift side by side with the current.
It strokes and so do I.
The school is small, seven or eight.
When the water muddies we lose each other.

lines.zh: 我们再聚起来，还是这几条。
lines.en: We gather again, the same few.
A round pebble on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了碰，不是吃的。
lines.en: I touch it with my mouth. Not food.
A torn leaf sank.
I swallowed it whole.
A fine line is caught on my fin.
I shake and cannot free it.
Something fell onto the surface.
I rose to look.
This stone is too big to swallow.
I sink back to the bed.
Something is circling on the surface.
I shift half a block upstream.
An insect is struggling on the surface.
I swim up from below.
The surface light falls on it.

lines.zh: 从这个角度看，它找不到我。
lines.en: From this angle it cannot find me.
Half a block between us.
I open my mouth slightly.
It is still moving on the surface.
I hold still underwater.
The current is bringing it to me.

lines.zh: 就是现在，我动了，河岸的水花一响。
lines.en: Now, I move; a splash at the riverbank.
I trail it along the bed.
Its shadow glides on the surface.
I rise slowly.
The current pushes me off.
I change direction twice.
It has landed on the surface.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等着水面上的影子。
lines.en: Mouth open, I wait for the shadow on the surface.

lines.zh: 它周围的波纹暴露了它。
lines.en: The ripples around it give it away.
I hold still and wait for it to relax.
Its wings have stopped.
The surface is still but for the ripples.

lines.zh: 我在地狱溪的河湾里游。
lines.en: I swim the bends of Hell Creek.
It is right at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一口吞下去，没溅起水。
lines.en: I swallow it without a splash.
The surface made one small sound.
A half-block fish barely fills a tooth gap.
It struggled twice and was gone.
I flick my tail, turn, and sink.
That bite was clean.

lines.zh: 我把头伸出水面，又收回。
lines.en: I lift my head out and draw it back.
The splash spreads in rings.
I missed and got a mouthful of water.

lines.zh: 我又咬了一口，这次咬实了。
lines.en: I bite again, and this time it holds.
This time I have it.

lines.zh: 那点肉，一口就滑进肚子。
lines.en: That morsel slides down in one gulp.

lines.zh: 我从石头下面的阴影里游出来。
lines.en: I slip out from the shadow under a stone.

lines.zh: 水底的沙在我身下散开。
lines.en: Sand scatters under me.
The water in this river is cold.

lines.zh: 我从河岸的洼处游进主水道。
lines.en: I swim from the bank hollow into the main channel.
One of my kind is a few blocks off.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床，慢慢往下游。
lines.en: I keep to the bed and drift downstream.
Surface light reaches the bed.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下鳍，稳住身体。
lines.en: I fan my fins and steady myself.
Reed shadows fall across the water.
I stop and listen to the water.

lines.zh: 红杉林边的河里，沙子细。
lines.en: The river by the redwoods has fine sand.
I rise to mid-water.
The bend is quiet.

lines.zh: 我把头朝向水流来的方向。
lines.en: I turn my head to where the water comes from.
The surface grew hot and I sank.

lines.zh: 水被抽走，我摔在河床上。
lines.en: The water was pulled away and I hit the bed.

lines.zh: 我被困在一小洼水里，动不了。
lines.en: Trapped in a small pool, I cannot move.

lines.zh: 爆响在水里震得我翻过去。
lines.en: The blast in the water rolled me over.
Something sharp went through me.

lines.zh: 地狱溪的水很清，我的鳞太薄。
lines.en: Hell Creek water is clear and my scales thin.

lines.zh: 水面上再也没有虫子落下。
lines.en: No more insects fall on the surface.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，我一动不动了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the surface and I went stiff.
The bed was gone and I fell into the dark.
